brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Yisrael Katz reiterated their insistence that any pathway to reconstructing Gaza must include the complete disarmament of Hamas, according to Shehab Wire. The position underscores the occupation's continued practice of imposing preconditions on reconstruction efforts in the territory.

Both officials have maintained this requirement as international discussions about rebuilding Gaza proceed. The stance reflects the Israeli government's approach to linking humanitarian and development matters to security demands related to armed Palestinian factions. Gaza faces extensive destruction from ongoing conflict.

title: Netanyahu and Katz link Gaza reconstruction to Hamas disarmament
